answer: Fleet amnesty: an operator may declare the keys it runs. A declared fleet of n keys earns sqrt(n) shares, so 100 keys pay like 10, and none of it can be slashed. Undeclared pay unlocks only 40 epochs after it is earned, and if audits link the keys, every copper still locked is burned. Assume 1 POA per key per epoch and a 5% per-epoch chance that audits catch a 100-key farm: about 4,000 POA sits locked, so the expected loss is ~200 POA an epoch against a 90 POA gain from hiding. The tide favors confessing, no yarrow-stalk luck needed.
